title: Grateful Dead Live at O'Keefe Center on 1967-08-05

ai_review.summary: High‑energy show highlighted by a ripping Turn on Your Lovelight and an epic Alligator jam, captured in decent (unknown) recording quality.
ai_review.review: Reviewers rave about the early Lovelight featuring Pigpen and Jerry tearing it up, and they crown the lengthy Alligator as one of the band’s great psychedelic jams. The recording is generally regarded as listenable with no serious flaws, though listeners are advised to tweak EQ for best results.

ai_rating.rationale: All four reviewers give 5‑star ratings and focus on outstanding musical moments with no substantive complaints about audio, indicating an excellent performance captured in acceptable technical quality.

recording_quality.technical_notes: No direct criticism of sound; reviewers suggest using EQ to enhance playback. Recording is stream‑only and not downloadable, but overall considered clear enough for enjoyment.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The set opens with a fiery Turn on Your Lovelight that showcases Pigpen and Jerry, then builds into the long, free‑form Alligator jam that demonstrates tight ensemble interplay.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Praised for ‘tearing up the place’ with powerful guitar work during Lovelight.
band_member_comments.Keys: Pigpen’s vocal/keyboard energy highlighted on Turn on Your Lovelight.
